title: Three-dimensional co-culture platform of human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived oligodendrocyte lineage cells and neurons for studying myelination
protocol: Coat a 12-well tissue culture plate with Matrigel in DMEM/F12.
Prepare hiPSC medium containing 10 μM ROCK inhibitor (Y-27632).
Warm up hiPSC medium and DMEM/F12 to 37°C, and Accutase to RT (20°C–25°C).
Aspirate the spent hiPSC medium.
Wash cells once with 1× DPBS without calcium and magnesium (1 mL/well).
Add Accutase (0.5 mL/well) to the wells.
Incubate for 5 min in an incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Add DMEM/F12 onto the Accutase-containing wells (1 mL/well).
Transfer cells mechanically with a P1000 into a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at RT (20°C–25°C).
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend cells in hiPSC medium (5 mL).
Plate 800,000 cells per well on a Matrigel-coated 12-well tissue culture plate.
Incubate cells in an incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Change the medium to neural induction medium 1 (NIM-1) after 24 h.
Perform all steps under sterile conditions in a laminar flow cabinet.
Aspirate the spent hiPSC medium from wells.
Add fresh neural induction medium 1 (NIM-1) (1.5 mL/well).
Incubate cells at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 24 hours.
Replace the medium with fresh NIM-1 daily for the following 12 days.
Passage cells on DIV12 of the neuronal differentiation protocol.
Coat a 12-well tissue culture plate with Matrigel in DMEM/F12.
Prepare culture medium (NIM-1) containing 10 μM ROCK inhibitor (Y-27632).
Warm up culture medium and DMEM/F12 to 37°C.
Warm up Accutase to room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Aspirate the spent culture medium.
Wash cells once with 1× DPBS without calcium and magnesium (1 mL/well).
Add Accutase (0.5 mL/well) to the wells.
Incubate for 5 min in an incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Add DMEM/F12 onto the Accutase-containing wells (1 mL/well).
Detach cells mechanically with a P1000.
Transfer detached cells into a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in culture medium (e.g., 5 mL).
Plate 1.1 million cells per well on a Matrigel-coated 12-well tissue culture plate.
Incubate cells in an incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Change the medium to neural maintenance medium (NMM) after 24 h.
On DIV13, change the medium from neural induction medium 1 (NIM-1) to neural maintenance medium (NMM).
Passage cells on DIV18, DIV25, and DIV32 of the differentiation protocol.
Perform all steps under sterile conditions in a laminar flow cabinet.
Coat 12-well tissue culture plate with Matrigel in DMEM/F12.
Prepare culture medium containing 10 μM ROCK inhibitor for DIV18 and DIV25 (NMM) and for DIV32 (FMM).
Prepare DMEM/F12 containing 10 μM ROCK inhibitor (Y-27632) at 15 mL per sample.
Warm up the culture medium and DMEM/F12 to 37°C.
Aspirate spent culture medium from wells.
Wash cells once with DMEM/F12 (1 mL/well).
Add STEMdiff™ Neural Rosette Selection Reagent (0.5 mL/well) and incubate for 1 hour at 37°C in a 5% CO2 environment.
Monitor cells under an optical microscope after 1 hour of incubation.
If cells show white margins, proceed to detachment; otherwise, continue incubating up to 1.5 hours maximum.
Aspirate Neural Rosette Selection Reagent from wells.
Add DMEM/F12 containing 10 μM ROCK inhibitor (Y-27632) (1 mL/well).
Mechanically detach cells using a P1000 pipette.
Repeat mechanical detachment two more times and collect detached cells in a 15 mL conical tube.
Fill up the 15 mL conical tube to its maximum volume of 15 mL with DMEM/F12 containing ROCK inhibitor.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 minutes at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Resuspend cells with culture medium (e.g., 5 mL).
Plate 200,000 cells per well on Matrigel-coated 12-well tissue culture plates.
Incubate cells in an incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Aspirate the spent culture medium.
Wash cells once with 1× DPBS without calcium and magnesium (1 mL/well).
Add Accutase (0.5 mL/well) and incubate for 5 min in the incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Add DMEM/F12 onto the Accutase-containing wells (1 mL/well).
Detach cells mechanically with a P1000 and transfer them into a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend cells with culture medium (e.g., 5 mL).
Plate 200,000 cells per well on Matrigel-coated 12-well tissue culture plates.
Incubate cells in an incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Perform the next medium change after 24 hours for neurobasal medium (NMM) or after 48 hours for feeder mouse medium (FMM).
Examine neural progenitor stage by testing for the expression of neural progenitor markers using immunofluorescence staining.
Plate NPCs on DIV18 to glass bottom plates during passaging and culture for 3-4 more days (DIV21 – DIV22).
Fix cells with cold 4% Paraformaldehyde for 15 min at RT (20°C–25°C) for immunocytochemistry.
Change medium from neural maintenance medium to final maturation medium on DIV26.
Change the medium every other day after switching to final maturation medium.
Freeze NPCs between DIV18 and DIV30 and store in liquid nitrogen during passaging procedures (DIV18 and DIV25).
Resuspend cells with cold NPC freezing medium (∼ 800 μL per cryovial) after centrifugation step during passaging.
Place cryovials in freezing containers and store at -80°C freezer for ideal cryopreservation (-1°C/minute).
Transfer cryovials to liquid nitrogen after 24 hours for long-term storage.
Plate hiPSC-derived neural progenitor cells (NPCs) on 3D nanofibers at DIV38.
Perform all steps under sterile conditions in a laminar flow cabinet.
Treat and coat 3D nanofibers properly with Matrigel in DMEM/F12 before use.
Use an enzyme-free reagent for selective detachment of hiPSC-derived NPCs on DIV38.
Alternatively, detach cells using Accutase according to previous descriptions.
Plate approximately 200,000 cells per well of a 24-well 3D nanomatrix plate.
Perform all steps under sterile conditions in a laminar flow cabinet.
Change the medium partially (∼ 1.5 ml/well) every other day using FMM.
From DIV60 onwards, perform the medium change gently with a P1000 to ensure cells do not detach.
Fix cells at favored timepoints during final maturation phase with cold 4% PFA for 20 min at RT (20°C–25°C).
Transfer single inserts of the 24-well 3D nanomatrix plate into a 12-well tissue culture plate using forceps and spatula.
Follow immunocytochemistry protocol instructions as described in the section ‘Analysis of co-culture of hiPSC-derived neurons and oligodendrocyte lineage cells on 3D nanofibers’.
Coat a 6-well tissue culture plate with Matrigel in DMEM/F12.
Prepare hiPSC medium containing 10 μM ROCK inhibitor (Y-27632).
Warm up hiPSC medium and DMEM/F12 to 37°C.
Warm Accutase to room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Aspirate the spent hiPSC medium.
Wash cells once with 1× DPBS without calcium and magnesium (1 mL/well).
Add Accutase (0.5 mL/well) to the wells.
Incubate for 5 min in the incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Add DMEM/F12 onto the Accutase-containing wells (1 mL/well).
Detach cells mechanically with a P1000 and transfer them into a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in hiPSC medium (e.g., 5 mL).
Plate 200,000 cells per well on a Matrigel-coated 6-well tissue culture plate.
Incubate cells in an incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Perform the next medium change after 24 h with hiPSC medium.
Change the medium from hiPSC medium to neural induction medium 2 (NIM-2) three days after plating hiPSCs for differentiation.
Prepare and warm up culture medium (NIM-2) for neural induction under sterile conditions in a laminar flow cabinet.
Aspirate the spent hiPSC medium from wells.
Add fresh neural induction medium (NIM-2), 1.5 mL per well, to cells.
Incubate cells in an incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Change the medium after 24 hours with NIM-2 under sterile conditions.
Daily replace the medium with fresh neural induction medium 2 (NIM-2) until DIV8.
Add GANT61 only for the first 5 days of the neural induction phase.
Change the medium from NIM-2 to N2 medium on DIV8.
Daily replace the medium with fresh N2 medium until DIV12.
Optional: Fix cells with cold 4% PFA for 15 min at room temperature and test for expression of progenitor markers (e.g., PAX6 and OLIG2) using immunofluorescence staining.
On DIV12, change the medium from N2 medium to N2B27 medium.
Warm up culture medium and DMEM/F12 to 37°C, and Accutase to RT (20°C–25°C).
Aspirate the spent culture medium and wash cells once with 1× DPBS without calcium and magnesium (1 mL/well).
Add Accutase (0.5 mL/well) and incubate for 5 min in the incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Add DMEM/F12 onto the Accutase-containing wells (1 mL/well).
Detach the cells mechanically with a P1000 and transfer them into a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge: 200 × g, 4 min, RT (20°C–25°C).
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend cells with culture medium (1 mL).
Plate cells (0.5 mL/well) on 6-well ultra-low attachment plates and fill up the well with N2B27 medium to a total of 3 mL/well.
Incubate cells in an incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Every other day (DIV14 to DIV18), replace with fresh N2B27 medium.
Transfer the OLIG2-enriched spheres and the medium into a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge at 100 × g for 2 minutes at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Aspirate 2/3 of the medium and add fresh N2B27 medium (2 mL/well).
Put OLIG2-enriched spheres back to the same 6-well ultra-low attachment plate using a pipette and distribute them equally.
Incubate cells in an incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
On DIV20 of the protocol, change the medium from N2B27 to PDGF medium.
Every other day (DIV20 to DIV28), replace the medium with fresh PDGF medium: Transfer the OLIG2-enriched spheres and the medium into a 15 mL conical tube.
Wait for the OLIG2-enriched spheres to sink down (∼3 min).
Aspirate 2/3 of the medium and add fresh PDGF medium (2 mL/well).
Put OLIG2-enriched spheres back to the same 6-well ultra-low attachment plate using a pipette and distribute them equally.
Incubate cells in an incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Select OLIG2-enriched spheres with an optical microscope under sterile conditions.
Pretreat and coat 24-well 3D nanomatrix plate inserts containing the 3D nanofibers with Matrigel in DMEM/F12.
Prepare culture medium (Glial medium) containing 10 μM ROCK inhibitor (Y-27632).
Warm up culture medium to 37°C.
Add Glial medium (1.5 mL/well) to the prepared 24-well plates.
Select appropriate OLIG2-enriched spheres with a P200 pipette.
Plate selected OLIG2-enriched spheres on the 3D nanofiber network.
Distribute OLIG2-enriched spheres within the well so that they are separate from each other and do not form clumps.
Maintain oligodendrocyte lineage cells on 3D nanofibers from DIV30 to DIV75.
Perform partial medium changes with 2/3 fresh culture medium every other day starting from DIV32 onwards.
Use a P1000 gently for medium changes from DIV32 onwards to ensure that the cells do not detach.
Change culture medium of neurons (FMM) to co-culture medium (1.5–2 mL/well).
Change culture medium of oligodendrocytes (Glial medium) to co-culture medium (1.5 mL/well).
Prepare MACS buffer and store at 4°C.
Prepare MACS buffer with FcR blocker by mixing 77 μL MACS buffer and 10 μL FcR per sample.
Store MACS buffer with FcR blocker at 4°C.
Prepare MACS microbeads mixture by combining 10 μL anti-O4 microbeads and 3 μL anti-AN2 microbeads per sample.
Store MACS microbeads mixture at 4°C.
Prepare enzyme activation buffer (for Papain).
Prepare Papain and Ovomucoid.
Prepare co-culture medium containing 10 μM ROCK inhibitor (Y-27632).
Warm up co-culture medium containing 10 μM ROCK inhibitor (Y-27632) and DMEM/F12 to 37°C.
Warm up enzyme activation buffer to room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Add Papain to the enzyme activation buffer to achieve an activity of 20 units/mL.
Place the enzyme activation buffer containing Papain at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Remove the ring inside the well carefully with forceps.
Wash cells once with DMEM/F12.
Add activated Papain (0.5 mL/well) to the cells and place the plate in an incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 15 minutes.
Take out the plate from the incubator, add DMEM/F12 (1 mL/well).
Detach the cells mechanically with a P1000 and transfer cells into a 15 mL conical tube.
Apply pressure with a P1000 to detach cells from the 3D nanofibers without harming the cells.
Add Ovomucoid in a ratio of 1:1 with Papain, mix gently by pipetting up and down a few times (P1000).
Incubate for 1 min at RT (20°C–25°C).
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at RT (20°C–25°C).
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet with co-culture medium containing 10 μM ROCK inhibitor (Y-27632) in a volume of 1.5 mL.
Filter cells through a pre-wetted 70 μm cell strainer using 0.5 mL of co-culture medium containing 10 μM ROCK inhibitor (Y-27632).
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at RT (20°C–25°C).
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cells with MACS buffer/FcR blocker mixture in a total volume of 87 μL per sample and incubate for 10 min at 4°C.
Add anti-O4/anti-AN2 microbeads mixture in a total volume of 13 μL per sample, mix gently without vortexing.
Incubate for 30 min at 4°C.
Wash by adding MACS buffer (1 mL/sample) to the mixture and mix gently by pipetting up and down a few times.
Centrifuge: 300 × g, 5 min.
Aspirate the supernatant (as much as possible).
Resuspend the pellet with MACS buffer (0.5 mL/sample).
Prewet MS column by adding MACS buffer (0.5 mL).
Place the prewetted MS column in the magnetic field of the MACS separator.
Apply cell suspension onto the MS column (0.5 mL).
Wash the column 2 times by adding MACS buffer (1 mL) onto the MS column as soon as the reservoir is empty after applying cell suspension.
Add MACS buffer (1 mL) onto the MS column and immediately flush out the O4+/AN2+ cells by pushing the plunger into the column.
Repeat step of adding MACS buffer and flushing out O4+/AN2+ cells.
Collect an aliquot of the O4+/AN2+ cells if needed for future analysis.
Centrifuge isolated oligodendrocyte lineage cells (O4+/AN2+) at 400 × g, 5 min, RT (20°C–25°C).
Resuspend cells in oligodendrocyte lineage cell freezing medium (∼800 μL per cryovial).
Place cryovials in freezing containers.
Store cryovials in a -80°C freezer for ideal cryopreservation (-1°C/minute).
Transfer cryovials to liquid nitrogen after 24 hours for long-time storage.
Change co-culture medium of neurons already cultured in 3D nanomatrix plates to co-culture medium containing 10 μM ROCK inhibitor (Y-27632) (1.5–2 ml/well).
Centrifuge MACSorted O4+/AN2+ cells at 400 × g for 5 min at room temperature.
Resuspend cell pellet with co-culture medium containing 10 μM ROCK inhibitor (Y-27632).
Plate O4+/AN2+ cells on top of neurons which were cultured already in the 3D nanomatrix plates.
Store cells in an incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Change co-culture medium of neurons which were already cultured on the 3D nanofibers to co-culture medium containing 10 μM ROCK inhibitor (Y-27632).
Take out the frozen cryovial containing the oligodendrocyte lineage cells from the liquid nitrogen tank.
Transfer the cryovials under the laminar flow cabinet and let them adapt to room temperature for 2 minutes.
Take up the vial content containing O4+/AN2+ cells in freezing medium with a P1000 and transfer to a 15 mL conical tube.
Add DMEM/F12 slowly drop by drop to the contents in the 15 mL conical tube while swirling gently.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 minutes at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet with co-culture medium containing 10 μM ROCK inhibitor (Y-27632).
Plate O4+/AN2+ cells on top of neurons cultured on 3D nanomatrix plates.
Store the plated cells in an incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Perform a medium change with co-culture medium after 48 hours.
Perform a partial medium change (∼ 1.5 mL/well) every other day until the end of the co-culture (up to 21 days).
Take out spent co-culture medium (∼ 1.5 mL/well) gently with a P1000.
Add fresh co-culture medium (∼ 1.5 mL/well) gently with a P1000.
Store cells in an incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Prepare and warm up co-culture medium to 37°C for the next medium change after 48 hours.
Take out the insert from the 24-well 3D nanomatrix plate using forceps and spatula.
Transfer the insert to a new well of a 12-well tissue culture plate.
Fix cells in cold 4% PFA for 20 minutes at room temperature (RT).
Wash cells twice with 1× DPBS without calcium and magnesium.
Block and permeabilize cells with 5% BSA and 0.1% Triton X-100 in 1× DPBS for 2 hours at RT with gentle agitation.
Prepare primary antibodies in 2.5% BSA and 0.1% Triton X-100 in 1× DPBS and incubate overnight (18–20 hours) at 4°C with gentle agitation in the dark.
Wash cells three times with 1× DPBS for 10 minutes at RT with gentle agitation.
Prepare secondary antibodies in 2.5% BSA in 1× DPBS and incubate for 1 hour at RT with gentle agitation in the dark.
Wash cells three times with 1× DPBS for 10 minutes at RT with gentle agitation in the dark.
Stain nuclei with Hoechst 33342 (2 μM) in 1× DPBS for 5 minutes at RT with gentle agitation in the dark.
Wash cells twice with 1× DPBS for 10 minutes at RT with gentle agitation in the dark.
Mount insert with VectaShield (∼100 μL/well) in a 24-well glass bottom plate suitable for imaging.
Fix the 24-well 3D nanomatrix plate insert containing cells in 2.5% glutaraldehyde in 100 mM cacodylate buffer (pH 7.2) for 30 min at room temperature.
Monitor the direction of the nanofibers and cells at an optical microscope.
Monitor the direction of the nanofibers.
Cut out a small piece (rectangle, 1 cm × 0.5 cm) from the 24-well 3D nanomatrix plate insert with surgical scissors to fit the mold for embedding.
Mark one corner of the cut-out rectangle with surgical scissors to track the orientation of the nanofibers and cells.
Place the sample in 2.5% glutaraldehyde in 100 mM cacodylate buffer (pH 7.2) at 4°C overnight (18–20 hours).
Rinse the sample three times in 100 mM cacodylate buffer.
Fix the sample in 1% osmium in 100 mM cacodylate buffer for 30 min on ice.
Wash the sample with water three times for 5 min each.
Incubate the sample in 1% uranyl acetate in water at 4°C overnight (18–20 h).
Dehydrate the sample in an ethanol gradient of 50%, 70%, 90%, and 95% for 5 min each, followed by two steps with 100% ethanol.
Infiltrate stepwise with embedding medium (Spurr resin): first at 50% for 1 h, then at 75% for 1 h, and finally twice at 100%, once for 1 hour and again overnight (18–20 h).
Polymerize the sample at 50°C for 48 hours.
Section the block in 70 nm thin sections using a diamond knife and a Leica UC7 ultramicrotome in the direction to cross-section the nanofibers and cells.
Collect the sections on pioloform-coated slot grids.
Post-stain the sections with 3% uranyl acetate in 70% methanol for 5 min.
Post-stain the sections with lead citrate for 3 min.
Prepare lead citrate using 1.3 M trisodium citrate, 1 M lead nitrate, and 1 M NaOH in distilled water.
Image the sections on an JEOL JEM-1400 electron microscope operating at 80 kV and equipped with a 4K TemCam F416 camera.
